summary.en: An accent word rises and warps beat by beat, ghosts smearing off it, while an ink word slams under it with its full stop.
summary.zh: 一个强调色的词升起并一拍拍扭曲，带着拖影；下面一个黑字砸下，带着句号。

fits: A problem that is unstable or blamed: "blame everyone", "flaky tests".
notFor: a calm statement; a word that must be read exactly (the warp blurs it).

intent.en: Instability made visible: the problem word cannot hold its shape while the plain word under it lands hard.
intent.zh: 让不稳定看得见：问题词保持不住形状，下面那个平实的词却重重落下。

content.en: Two single words (≤ 10 chars), an optional label.
content.zh: 两个单词（每个 ≤ 4 字），可选标签。

fits.zh: 不稳定或互相甩锅的问题：“甩锅给所有人”“测试时好时坏”。

notFor.zh: 平静的陈述；必须精确读到的词（扭曲会让它模糊）。

en: The warped word is the one place the accent colours a word: use it once in a film.
zh: 扭曲的词是强调色唯一能给字上色的地方：一部片只用一次。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
